subject: Request: temporary version escrow & adoption matrix for Nimbus Aurora v2
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary version escrow & adoption matrix for Nimbus Aurora v2

Team —

Quick ask as we evaluate Nimbus's new Aurora v2 (7B) variants for hosted availability. Partnerships flagged a pilot that would push traffic to Aurora-v2-small and Aurora-v2-base. Before we greenlight any rollout, product needs a short-lived "escrow"/pin assignment and a compatibility/adoption matrix so we can: 

- enumerate variant-to-serving-mode compatibility (streaming, kv-cache sizes, quantization tiers)
- decide if we should route to v2-small for low-latency paths vs. v2-base for quality paths
- set a provisional version escrow (48–72h) while we complete stability tests and telemetry hooks

Can Marissa lead the compatibility matrix and propose an escrow window? Laura — please flag any stability gating (staging-only vs. canary) we should enforce. Ben, can you estimate infra impact (ops runbook + burst capacity needed) for a 1w pilot?

Attachments: I asked Nimbus for an adoption matrix and benchmark PDFs (attached). Jira INF-4432 is the tracking ticket.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Product — Inference
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary version escrow & adoption matrix for Nimbus Aurora v2

Karthik —

I can own the matrix. Initial plan:

1) Compatibility matrix spreadsheet (attached) — mapping variant -> serialized tokenizer, kv-cache footprint @ token lengths 512/2048, quantization caveats (FP16 vs int8 fallback), and supported runtime optimizations.
2) Quick smoke: staged inference runs (100 concurrent sessions) against v2-small and v2-base to collect latency P50/P95, OOM flags, and kv-cache hit ratios. I’ll run these in our staging fleet and post results in INF-4432.
3) Escrow window suggestion: provisional 72-hour version escrow (no automatic rollout) while we validate telemetry and do one canary day. If all green, reduce to a rolling canary policy.

Open question for Laura: are there known tokenizer differences between Aurora-v1 and v2 that should trigger a tighter gating? If so, we should broaden the escrow to include tokenization regression evals.

I’ll aim to have the matrix + smoke bench results uploaded by EOD tomorrow (Mon).

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Model Onboarding Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachment: nimbus-adoption-matrix.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 08:59:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary version escrow & adoption matrix for Nimbus Aurora v2

Marissa / team —

Short answers:

- Tokenizer: there is a minor change in subword splitting with v2 that can cause ~0.4% BLEU-style delta on certain evals; we need to run our regression prompt set (INF-REG-9) during the escrow window.
- Stability gate: require staging 24h with production-like concurrency and a forced KV cache warmup pass. If we see any OOM or >5% tail latency regressions on the benchmark, hold the escrow.
- Escrow duration: I support the 72-hour provisional window, but make the first 24h "staging-only" and the next 48h as controlled canary (1% traffic).

Marissa — please add the regression prompt set link to the matrix doc and tag the exact commit/hash of the test harness you use. Ben — if you need more than the standard canary capacity, call it out in INF-4432 with rough GPU-hours.

Thanks,
Laura
Principal Reliability Engineer — Serving
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Partnerships <partnerships@nimbus.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 22:04:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: temporary version escrow & adoption matrix for Nimbus Aurora v2

Sara —

Looping you in with our internal plan. Summary below (forwarded):

- Marissa will deliver a compatibility/adoption matrix and smoke benchmarks (expected EOD Mon) — attached.
- We propose a provisional 72-hour version escrow for Aurora v2 variants: 24h staging-only validation, then 48h controlled canary at ~1% traffic.
- Regression evals (INF-REG-9) will run during the escrow window to catch tokenizer/quality regressions.
- If staging shows OOMs or P95 regressions >5%, we will hold the variant.

Can you confirm the exact artifact names and checksums for the v2-small and v2-base model bundles so we can pin to the right artifact during the escrow? Also confirm whether Nimbus expects any runtime flags for int8 fallback (Marissa will add these to the matrix).

Appreciate a quick turnaround so we can unblock partnerships and scheduling.

Best,
Karthik
